provenance_statuses.verified: An independent source file exists outside the public site and archive, and source_sha256 verifies it.
provenance_statuses.derived: The public asset was derived from another manifest-listed public asset whose hash and relationship are recorded.
provenance_statuses.missing: No independent source file is retained. The public file is not treated as its own provenance.

artifact_genesis_categories.recovered_historical_export: A retained export of a historical working or product artifact, not created for the 2026 portfolio.
artifact_genesis_categories.crop_of_recovered_historical_export: A portfolio crop made from a retained historical working or product artifact.
artifact_genesis_categories.portfolio_reconstruction_2026: A frame or crop created or materially reconstructed in 2026 to demonstrate a portfolio idea; it is not historical product evidence.

visual_selection_catalog.scope: Image-bearing files in the DeepL case-study records below; text-only exhibits and non-DeepL media remain outside this image shortlist.
visual_selection_catalog.decision_rule: Choose for reader value first: polished presentation and clarity, believable product context, and a real content-design or UX-copywriting decision that a hiring reader can see. Review the available image itself before deciding. Packets, filenames, folder placement, and earlier suggestions are discovery aids only. Provenance limits lifecycle, adoption, and results language; it does not automatically disqualify a visually strong asset.

tiers.A: First-look candidate: strong presentation, product context, and a legible content decision.
tiers.B: Strong reserve: useful reader value, but narrower, more iterative, or more context-dependent.
tiers.C: Supporting candidate: usable for a specific state or comparison, but not a lead exhibit.
